key.name: panel-activities-button
key.description: The workspace indicator on the left of the top bar.

key.name: clock-style
key.summary: What the top bar clock shows
key.description: "default" is GNOME's own clock, which follows the Date & Time settings; "time" leaves out the date and weekday.

key.name: hidden-quick-settings
key.description: Ids of grid items and top row buttons left out of the Quick Settings menu, see src/lib/quickSettingsCatalog.js. Items of other extensions use "ext:" plus their class name.

key.name: quick-settings-order
key.summary: Order of the Quick Settings items
key.description: Item ids in the order they are laid out, row by row. Empty keeps GNOME's order. Items not in the list go where GNOME would put them.

key.name: quick-settings-widths
key.description: Item id mapped to the number of columns it spans; 0 means all columns. Items not listed keep GNOME's width (sliders and the top row span all columns).

key.name: quick-settings-columns
key.description: The menu gets wider with more columns.

key.name: known-quick-settings-items
key.summary: Other extensions' Quick Settings items seen so far
key.description: Item id mapped to its name, in the order GNOME adds them. Filled in by the extension so the preferences can list them.

key.name: known-quick-settings-icons
key.summary: Icons of other extensions' Quick Settings items
key.description: Item id mapped to an icon name, for the preview in the preferences.

key.name: known-quick-settings-kinds
key.summary: Shapes of other extensions' Quick Settings items
key.description: Item id mapped to "slider", "row" (full width) or "tile", for the preview in the preferences.

key.name: present-quick-settings-items
key.summary: Quick Settings items GNOME shows right now
key.description: Filled in by the extension for the preview in the preferences.

key.name: quick-settings-prefs-button
key.summary: Show a jh-fixes Settings button in Quick Settings
key.description: Next to GNOME's Settings button in the top row; opens these preferences.

key.name: ddc-brightness
key.description: Adds a Quick Settings slider that sets the brightness of every DDC/CI monitor at once, using ddcutil.

key.name: sound-app-volumes
key.summary: Application volume sliders in Quick Settings
key.description: Show a volume slider for every app playing sound in the Quick Settings sound output menu.

key.name: known-output-devices
key.description: Device key mapped to the name GNOME gives it. Filled in by the extension so the preferences can list devices that are not plugged in right now.

key.name: output-device-names
key.description: Device key mapped to the name shown in Quick Settings.

key.name: hidden-output-devices
key.description: Device keys left out of the Quick Settings output menu. The active device is always shown.

key.name: known-input-devices
key.description: Device key mapped to the name GNOME gives it. Filled in by the extension so the preferences can list devices that are not plugged in right now.

key.name: input-device-names
key.description: Device key mapped to the name shown in Quick Settings.

key.name: hidden-input-devices
key.description: Device keys left out of the Quick Settings input menu. The active device is always shown.

key.name: dash-max-icon-size
key.description: Upper limit for the Overview dash icons, in pixels. GNOME uses the steps 16, 22, 24, 32, 48 and 64, and still shrinks the icons if they do not fit.

key.name: dash-show-apps-button
key.summary: Show the Show Apps button in the dash

key.name: overview-window-titles
key.summary: Show window titles in the Overview
key.description: The caption (window title, or app name) under a window when the pointer is on it.

key.name: app-grid-columns
key.description: 0 lets GNOME choose (or follows the rows and the page's shape).

key.name: app-grid-rows
key.description: 0 lets GNOME choose (or follows the columns and the page's shape).

key.name: window-corners
key.description: Also gives them a matching shadow. Skips maximised and fullscreen windows and libadwaita apps, which are rounded already. The radius follows shell-theme-radius.

key.name: show-desktop
key.description: The shortcut in show-desktop-shortcut minimises every window on the workspace; pressing it again brings them back.

key.name: show-desktop-shortcut
key.description: Only used while show-desktop is on.

key.name: alt-tab-mode
key.description: "apps" as in GNOME, or "windows": the switch-applications shortcut opens the window switcher.

key.name: alt-tab-window-style
key.summary: How the window switcher shows windows
key.description: "gnome" follows org.gnome.shell.window-switcher app-icon-mode; "thumbnails", "icons" (app icons) or "both".

key.name: alt-tab-popup-delay
key.description: How long the switcher waits before it appears, so quick presses don't flash it. GNOME uses 150.

key.name: shell-theme
key.description: Built from GNOME's own dark stylesheet, replaces the User Themes extension.

key.name: shell-theme-darkness
key.summary: How dark the theme's greys are, in percent
key.description: 0 keeps GNOME's own dark greys, 100 uses Umbra's darker ones.

key.name: shell-theme-disabled-styles
key.summary: Umbra style parts that are switched off
key.description: Ids from STYLE_PARTS in src/features/appearance/theme/build.js. Those in FIXED_PARTS (switches, quick-settings, calendar) are always on and ignored here.

key.name: shell-theme-panel
key.description: "black" as in GNOME, "theme" uses the theme's background grey, "transparent" shows the wallpaper, "dynamic" is transparent until a window touches the bar and then shell-theme-panel-solid. The Overview and lock screen always have a transparent top bar.

key.name: shell-theme-panel-solid
key.summary: Dynamic top bar background while a window touches it
key.description: Only used while shell-theme-panel is "dynamic".

key.name: shell-theme-panel-shadow
key.summary: Text and icon shadow on a transparent top bar, in percent
key.description: 0 turns it off. Only used while the top bar is transparent ("transparent", or "dynamic" with no window touching it).

key.name: shell-theme-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the shell, in pixels
key.description: The popup menus' radius. Every other rounded corner scales with it: the Umbra theme's (Quick Settings, its submenus, the dash, the calendar and its cards) and, with window-corners on, the windows' (15 at the default 20).

key.name: shell-theme-slider-height
key.summary: Quick Settings slider thickness, in pixels

key.name: shell-theme-menu-shadow
key.summary: Popup menu shadow strength, in percent

key.name: shell-theme-dash-style
key.description: "umbra" is the compact pill with a thin outline, "gnome" keeps GNOME's own dash. Both have the colour of a Quick Settings tile that is off.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: How long shell animations take compared to normal. Lower is faster.
